name: VulcanDB
tagline: Short-lived object-oriented mobile database engine for .NET from Visual Objects.Net (c. 2012-2016).
description: VulcanDB was a commercial object-oriented database engine for the .NET environment, written in C# by Visual Objects.Net and positioned for mobile and desktop applications that wanted to persist .NET objects without an ORM. Very little technical documentation survives: the product site required JavaScript, its archived copies are sparse, and by 2017 the vulcandb.com domain had been taken over by an unrelated gambling site. dbdb.io dates the product from 2012 to 2016. Treat it as a historical entry only; LiteDB, Realm or ObjectBox are the maintained options for embedded object storage in .NET.
statusNote: Vendor and product gone by about 2016; vulcandb.com now hosts an unrelated site. Use LiteDB, Realm or ObjectBox instead.
strengths: Native .NET object persistence without ORM mapping (as marketed)
Small footprint aimed at mobile devices
weaknesses: Discontinued with no remaining downloads or documentation
useCases: Historical reference in surveys of .NET object databases
Identifying legacy apps built on it
